conditions.text: C1 — 1.1.64: the part from the last vowel to the end is called टि; its pradeśas are the rules that name टि (टित आत्मनेपदानां टेरे 3.4.79 …).

quotes.quote: अचां संनिविष्टानां योऽन्त्योऽच्, तदादि शब्दरूपं टिसंज्ञं भवति।

groups.group: named by a commentator | vidhi | X (English)
groups.how_checked: Vasu passages read; Kāśikā at both sūtras.

not_licensed.line: 3.2.15 named by Vasu  ⟨टि = from the last vowel to the end⟩
not_licensed.why: Vasu explains the ड् of डच् in the vārttika गिरौ डश्छन्दसि (गिरिशः); 3.2.15 itself teaches अच् and names no टि.

quotes.quote: The letter ड of डच् is indicatory denoting that there is elision of the final vowel with what follows it [[1.1.64]]

not_licensed.line: 4.1.13 named by Vasu  ⟨टि = from the last vowel to the end⟩
not_licensed.why: The ḍit डाप् makes the टि of पामन् drop — by 6.4.143 टेः, in the derivation; reading 4.1.13 (डाप् after मन्/अन्) needs no टि.

quotes.quote: the letter ड् indicates that the affix is to be added after the elision of the टि [[1.1.64]] of the base.
टिसंज्ञकस्य डिति प्रत्यये परतो लोपो भवति।

groups.group: own word, data case 6 | ādeśa | X
groups.note: licensed 2 · not licensed 0 · unsure 0 — Licensed: टेः is read through 1.1.64 (3.4.79 is Kāśikā's named pradeśa).

groups.group: named by a commentator | ekādeśa | X

not_licensed.line: 6.1.94 named by बालमनोरमा  ⟨टि = from the last vowel to the end⟩
not_licensed.why: BM introduces 1.1.64 here (in SK order) for the vārttika शकन्ध्वादिषु पररूपं वाच्यम्, which needs टि; 6.1.94 itself (पररूप of an upasarga's अ before an एङ्-initial dhātu) names no टि.

quotes.quote: अथ क्वचिट्टेः पररूपं विधातुं टिसंज्ञामाह-अचोऽन्त्यादि टि ।

groups.group: named by a commentator | svara | X
groups.how_checked: Nyāsa passage; our vṛtti carries टेः from 8.2.89.
groups.note: licensed 1 · not licensed 0 · unsure 0 — Licensed: टेः is carried from 8.2.89 into 8.2.90 (our vṛtti: "याज्यायाः अन्त्यस्य टेः"), and Nyāsa discusses it via 1.1.64.

missed.why: टेः (lopa before a ḍit) — the core टि rule; no 1.1.64 credit. Script: every sūtra whose own or carried words include टेः/टि without a 1.1.64 entry → 5.3.71, 6.4.143, 6.4.155, 7.1.88, 8.2.82, 8.2.89 (6 sūtras; 6.4.144/145 were added in the current build).

quotes.quote: टिसंज्ञकस्य डिति प्रत्यये परतो लोपो भवति।

missed.why: अकच् is placed before the टि.

quotes.quote: स च प्राक् टेः, न परतः।

missed.why: वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुत उदात्तः (adhikāra) — and 8.2.89 प्रणवष्टेः.

quotes.quote: वाक्यस्य टेरिति, प्लुत इति च, उदात्त इति च, एतत्त्रयमप्यधिकृतं
